purpose: Register governed content/recovery/design programs that may advance alongside the active application software roadmap without acquiring application implementation authority.
execution_rules: ENV and CEW may produce governed planning, source recovery, content, taxonomy, coverage, provenance and integration-contract artifacts while the application roadmap advances independently.
ENV and CEW may not mutate Multiversal-app runtime/application behavior without a separately selected and governed application-integration tranche.
The active software pointer remains authoritative for application implementation; this registry is not an alternate implementation selector.
ENV owns environment composition and Habitat Signature semantics; CEW owns creature ecology/distribution/classification and consumes ENV habitat semantics.

Havalaea native-born Time-of-Troubles-descended fauna with owner/source-supported human-level intelligence/personhood remain animal ecology identities and are eligible for existing NPC-system projection.
Mount, pet/companion and familiar are pathway/relationship capabilities, not base creature types; existing CCP authorities remain controlling.
integration_boundary: A future governed software tranche may consume finalized ENV/CEW packages. Until then, no runtime schema, UI, migration, SCL terrain, encounter, creature/NPC, mount, pet or familiar implementation is authorized by this registry.
